title: Streaming the partial-transpose moment hierarchy with order-independent quantum memory
summary: Partial transposition reveals mixed-state entanglement through the spectrum of $ρ_{AB}^{T_B}$, but this operator is not generally a physical state. Its power moments are accessible through collective permutations, whose coherent width grows with moment order. Here we introduce a streaming protocol that processes fresh copies sequentially while retaining one copy and a reusable ancilla. By realizing opposite cyclic permutations on the two subsystems, each measurement record yields unbiased estimators of all moments $p_2,\ldots,p_K$ through successive outcome products.
